decisions.reason: Pre-reflow moisture control for the AXP2101 does not change the NTC monitoring interface or battery thermal-protection behavior.
Baking the AXP2101 before reflow does not change the panel button, connector, PWRON signal, or control behavior.
The manufacturing precaution for the AXP2101 does not change the MT3608 boost rail, its GPIO control, or its powered loads.
The source addresses moisture damage during component reflow and does not alter copper-pour continuity, current capacity, or stitching-via requirements.
Replacing moisture-damaged AXP2101 samples and baking production components does not change the required battery, USB, charging, or system power-path behavior.
The source does not change the required handling of VBACKUP, PWROK, or VRTC.
The AXP2101 baking instruction does not modify electrical battery-protection functions, cutoff values, or DW01A circuitry.
AXP2101 moisture control during assembly does not affect the ESP32 decoupling capacitors or their placement.
The source does not change the charge-status display method, LED connector, resistor values, or population choices.
The reported moisture damage may explain defective samples, but it does not change the required DCDC1 voltage, rating, compensation, or rail-stability behavior.
The source does not affect the battery connector family, pitch, pin count, functions, part number, or unresolved pin order.
Pre-reflow baking addresses component moisture and does not resolve or change the AXP2101 or MT3608 decoupling-capacitor placement question.
